punchout-hd.name: plusnine's Punch-Out!! Wii HD-Ready Project
punchout-hd.description:
Having familiarized myself with Dolphin's texture dumping process, I thought i'd take a crack at one of my favorites for the Wii, Punch-Out!! For the most part the game already looks fantastic in 1080p and true to the NES and SNES classics, it plays like a total dream and is a fun challenge for players who like boxing games.

I am working with the NA version of the game (R7PE01), and have not tested it with any other editions.

Originally, I intended to only grapple with the title screen, UI, and HUD, but after seeing the textures all stream in one by one, I ended up giving most of the in-game particle effects a nice scale-up, too. I also started replacing character portraits to match the spiffy new UI theme, and did a few things to upgrade the arenas and a few other odds and ends.
punchout-hd.author: plusnine
